description: S457 3a — a name `event` the author declares is that binding inside a handler: a user `function event` called from `onclick=event(5)` runs. Before s457 the compiler's listener parameter was named `event` and shadowed it ("event is not a function" at click).
rationale: §5.2 "Handler values do not bind `event`": "A name `event` the author DID declare … is that binding inside every handler form" (ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S457 "1a 2a 3a 4a 5 dd it 6a", item 3: "the wrapper parameter is renamed out of the user namespace").
